content: If it is less than 12 hours before your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose entirely. Proceed to take your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Storage Instructions: Store this medication in its original container at room temperature. Ensure it is kept away from direct light and moisture. Do not store this medication in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific use. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Overdose Instructions: In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Medical and Laboratory Testing: Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as kidney function tests, may be conducted prior to starting this medication and periodically during its use. It is important to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose Instructions: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is less than 12 hours before your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Additional Notes on Storage: Keep the medication in its original container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed.
